contribution.ai: The agency reports that drone software first identified the two hikers.
contribution.people: An operator checked thermal imagery, the hikers signaled, and ground teams guided them to safety.
contribution.basis: One agency account describes the rescue, without measuring AI’s separate effect or time saved.

application.setting: A search near Jindabyne, Australia, as darkness fell.
conditions: Trained operator conducting an aerial grid search
Thermal confirmation and the hikers’ phone signal
Spotlight coordination with ground rescuers
application.limit: This account does not establish effectiveness in other terrain or weather.

contribution.ai: Software detected a possible ignition in a fixed camera feed and sent an alert.
contribution.people: Watchstanders confirm alerts in this program, and crews contained this fire.
contribution.basis: The program report compares the alert with the first 911 call, without establishing time saved or losses avoided.

application.setting: An ignition near Grass Valley, California, within camera coverage.
conditions: A camera viewing the ignition location
Alerts sent for trained watchstanders to confirm
Crews available to respond and contain the fire
application.limit: The account does not establish what detection, response, or fire size would have occurred without AI.

contribution.ai: qXR flagged a lung nodule on an X-ray taken before treatment for ulcerative colitis.
contribution.people: Clinicians reviewed the finding, investigated it with imaging and biopsy, and performed surgery.
contribution.basis: One patient in a case series, without a comparator that isolates AI’s effect or establishes a survival benefit.

application.setting: An incidental finding before planned anti-TNF treatment.
conditions: A chest X-ray obtained for another clinical purpose
Radiologist or pulmonologist review of the AI finding
Access to further imaging, tissue diagnosis, and surgery
application.limit: This selected case establishes no detection yield or survival improvement in another service.

contribution.ai: Annalise.ai flagged a chest X-ray for urgent review.
contribution.people: A GP referred the patient, and hospital staff reviewed the finding, contacted her, and arranged further investigation.
contribution.basis: The hospital account supplies no comparison of contact timing, cancer stage, or survival without AI.

application.setting: A Royal Surrey patient referred after a persistent cough.
conditions: Chest X-ray prioritized for clinician review
Staff available to contact the patient that afternoon
Further investigations arranged after the finding
application.limit: One patient’s pathway does not establish the effect on other patients’ outcomes.

contribution.ai: The hospital describes her care as part of its AI-supported imaging and coordination pathway.
contribution.people: Emergency responders transported her, and clinicians diagnosed the stroke and performed clot-removal surgery.
contribution.basis: No case-specific AI timing or comparison separates its contribution from emergency response, surgery, and other care.

application.setting: Stroke care at Brighton within a regional hospital network.
conditions: Brainomix software and a mobile app for sharing scans
Emergency transport and brain imaging
Access to clot-removal surgery
application.limit: The reported recovery does not establish AI’s separate effect or results in another care pathway.

contribution.ai: GPT-4 provided question-specific guidance and individualized feedback.
contribution.people: Instructors supplied solutions, prompts, videos, and structured practice, while students solved problems at their own pace.
contribution.basis: A randomized crossover study tested this whole teaching package against classroom active learning, without isolating the AI component.

application.setting: Two undergraduate physics lessons at Harvard.
conditions: Instructor-prepared prompts, correct solutions, and videos
Structured practice in surface tension and fluid flow
Self-paced use of the tutor at home
application.limit: Immediate test gains do not establish lasting learning or results in other subjects.

contribution.ai: Ithaca supplied 20 ranked suggestions for reconstructing missing characters.
contribution.people: Two Greek epigraphy specialists interpreted the suggestions using historical knowledge and searchable textual parallels.
contribution.basis: A comparative evaluation measured accuracy against known text that had been masked, without establishing accuracy on genuinely unknown inscriptions.

application.setting: Restoration of deliberately masked ancient Greek text.
conditions: Evaluators with seven years of relevant training
Ranked suggestions and searchable textual parallels
Known original text for checking accuracy
application.limit: Results do not establish accuracy for unknown text, other languages, or other groups of historians.

contribution.ai: A company-specific GPT-3 assistant suggested replies and relevant internal documentation.
contribution.people: Agents diagnosed problems and could ignore or edit suggestions, while managers continued coaching.
contribution.basis: A nonrandomized rollout compared agents before and after access with agents without access, so causal interpretation depends on the comparison assumptions.

application.setting: Live customer-support chats at one software company.
conditions: Fine-tuning on company support conversations and outcomes
Links to internal technical documentation
Three-hour onboarding and agent control over replies
application.limit: The gain varied by experience and skill and does not transfer directly to generic chatbots or other occupations.

contribution.ai: ChatGPT generated text in response to participants’ prompts.
contribution.people: Professionals prompted the system and chose what to submit, usually with little or no editing.
contribution.basis: Random assignment and blinded grading support a comparison on these short tasks, though some control participants also used ChatGPT.

application.setting: Short writing assignments tailored to participants’ occupations.
conditions: ChatGPT signup instructions and example prompts
Tasks requiring no precise facts or organization-specific knowledge
Quality-linked payments and blinded professional grading
application.limit: These results do not establish gains for research-heavy writing or productivity across a whole job.

contribution.ai: GitHub Copilot suggested code and functions for a JavaScript HTTP server.
contribution.people: Developers implemented and submitted the program, using their usual web resources.
contribution.basis: The randomized experiment’s time comparison includes successful completers only, and the difference in completion rates was not statistically significant.

conditions: Starter repository and explicit requirements
Twelve fixed correctness tests
Brief Copilot introduction and access to usual web resources
application.limit: Faster completion does not establish equivalent gains in existing codebases, team projects, security, or maintenance.
